kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتزم (form VIII)
# نَعْتَزِمُ (naʕtazimu) /naʕ.ta.zi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# نُعْتَزَمُ (nuʕtazamu) /nuʕ.ta.za.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# نَعْتَزِمَ (naʕtazima) /naʕ.ta.zi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# نُعْتَزَمَ (nuʕtazama) /nuʕ.ta.za.ma/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
